description: Following approval for the comprehensive redevelopment of land in Feltham town centre identified by the council as key site M21 (bounded by the railway line, Bedfont Lane, High Street and Highfield Road / Homecourt residential area) to include the demolition of existing residential accommodation, car parks, a public house, library and some retail and office premises and the erection of a mixed use development with extensive public transport improvements, including a new pedestrian footbridge to Feltham Interchange, food superstore, shops (A1), banks and professional and financial services (A2), restaurants (A3), offices (B1), health centre, library and residential (C3) together with improvements to surrounding access routes and the construction of car parks, access roads, enhanced pedestrian links to the surrounding area and landscaping - details submitted pursuant to condition 7 (noise) of 00609/BH/P2 (A) of permission dated 28/04/2002.
